newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Huarte lifts payments suspension.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Huarte lifts payments suspension.

text.p: Spanish construction firm Huarte said on Thursday it had had its suspension of payments lifted and would resume business as usual.
The troubled company suspended payments to suppliers in mid-March after a rescue plan failed.
"Huarte has lifted the suspension of payments after a court decision....and will immediately return to contracting work," the company said in a statement.
"During this nine month period the company has managed to control and overcome its crisis, reach an agreement with 6,000 creditors and find a new industrial partner," Huarte said.
The lifting of the suspension will enable Huarte to proceed with an "accordion" operation to reduce its capital to zero and then increase it to 10.04 billion pesetas.
It will also be able to continue with a second operation approved by shareholders to increase the company's share capital by 2.1 billion pesetas in exchange for previous debt.
The company said the lifting of the suspension also opened the way for a decision from the government's Official Credit Institute (ICO) on a loan.
